newtrip.title: New trip
newtrip.description: Choose the stops of the trip in the order the bus serves them. The editor finds the way between them on the map's vehicle lanes and shows it on the map; nothing is written before you create the trip. A stop marked * is added to the map's stops.
newtrip.stop.new.tooltip: This object is not a stop of the timetable yet; it is added with the trip
newtrip.stop.add.tooltip: Adds the stop to the end of the trip
newtrip.stop.selected.tooltip: Takes the object selected on the map as a stop, with the name typed here
newtrip.find.tooltip: Finds the way between the stops on the vehicle lanes and shows it on the map
newtrip.leg.existing: {from} to {to}: {length} m (the timetable has this link already)
newtrip.total: {count} stops, {length} m. Suggested running time: {minutes} minutes.
newtrip.field.name: Trip name
newtrip.status.failed: The trip could not be made: {reason}
newtrip.status.no_selection: Select an object on the map first.
newtrip.status.need_route: Find the way first; every stop must be reachable.
timetable.newline.tooltip: Makes a line file with one empty tour
timetable.newline.name: Line name
timetable.newline.create.tooltip: Makes the line; trips are added to its tours afterwards
timetable.newtrip.tooltip: Makes a trip over stops of the map, with its way
newtrip.stop.name: Name of a new stop
newtrip.stop.object.tooltip: Makes this object a stop of the timetable, with the name typed above (else its file name and ID)
newtrip.stop.none: The map has no stops yet. Place bus stop objects on the map first (the Objects tool), or select a stop object and use Add as stop.
project.lines.none: This map has no lines yet. Edit timetable... makes the first one.
